title: Băng giá
about: Round x2 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian): frozen. Cold, high glass glinting at random on the chords' tones and a deep sub, with a thin pad between, the middle left empty; a few glass notes far apart. C sharp minor at 50 bpm. An original piece.
